title: o-mcp/meters version 1
description: The instruments at one node as of a date: each device on the node or its feeder, what it reports and when it last did, and which quantities node_value can give for the node and how. Returned by node_meters. Times are site time with their offset. Unknown fields may appear in later version-1 documents; ignore them.

schema.description: Names the format. Check it, and version, before reading anything else.

version.description: Format version. Adding fields keeps it at 1; removing, renaming or changing the meaning of a field makes 2.

node.description: Code of the node the server resolved the request to.

as_of.description: Attachments as of this day, YYYY-MM-DD, site time.

observed_at.description: The instant reporting is judged at: now for today, else the end of the as_of day.

lookback_days.description: Days before observed_at that the reported quantities cover.

id.description: The node's graph.node.id, which stays when its code changes (design/frontend.md §5). The frontend stores it.

utilities.description: Utilities of the live edges at the node.

site_status.description: Status the site declared (normal or inactive); null when nothing is declared, or when as_of is before the declaration.

site_status_as_of.description: The day the status was declared.

devices.description: Every device on the node or on an edge into it, by code.

code.description: Device code; meter_readings takes it as device.

type.description: Device type, such as Power Meter or Flow Meter.

declared_status.description: The device register's status. It is not maintained: a silent device can still read ONLINE. Judge by observed.

brand.description: Manufacturer, as the device register records it (Schneider, Lovato; Generic when unknown). Null if not recorded.

model.description: Model, as recorded, such as PM5560 or DMG610. Null if not recorded.

protocol.description: How the device is read, as recorded, such as Modbus TCP. Null if not recorded.

gateway.description: The gateway (data concentrator) the device is polled through, identified by its address, as recorded; null if none is.

ip_address.description: The gateway's IP address on the plant network.

slave_id.description: The device's Modbus slave address behind its gateway, as recorded. Null if not recorded.

attached_to.description: NODE: the meter reads the node. FEEDER: it sits on the edge into the node, from feeder_from. A device the model reads on both gives its first quantity's place here; graph_quantities[].attached_to gives each quantity's.

edge.description: Id of the edge it sits on, for FEEDER.

feeder_from.description: Code of the node at the other end of that edge, for FEEDER.

graph_quantities.description: The quantities the network model reads from this device for this node.

multiplier.description: Factor applied to the reading (a CT ratio, a sign).

attached_to.description: Where the model reads this quantity from the device: NODE, or FEEDER, the edge given in edge. One device can be on both, such as a board's meter whose energy is on its feeder and whose voltage THD is on the board.

edge.description: Id of the edge, for FEEDER.

last_reading.description: Its latest reading at or before observed_at, within 90 days; null if none.

observed.description: REPORTING: read within 2 hours of observed_at. SILENT: last read earlier. NO_DATA: nothing in 90 days.

reported.description: Every quantity it reported in the lookback, by id.

code.description: Quantity code; null when the quantity is not in the vocabulary (an UNKNOWN_QUANTITY finding says so).

last_reading.description: Its latest 15-minute value in the lookback.

readings.description: How many 15-minute values it has in the lookback.

resolvable.description: What node_value can give for this node, per quantity of the node's utilities.

availability.description: MEASURED: a meter on the node or its feeder reports it. INFERRED: worked out from neighbouring meters by flow balance. INHERITED: taken from the feeder. DERIVED: computed from two other quantities. NOT_AVAILABLE: only a meter here could give it.

findings.description: What the server noticed. Show message as is.

code.description: NO_METER: no device on the node or its feeder. METER_SILENT: silent with nothing on record to explain it. SILENT_AS_DECLARED: silent, as the site's inactive status explains. STATUS_OUT_OF_DATE: declared inactive but reporting. UNKNOWN_QUANTITY: a reported quantity id with no vocabulary entry.

device.description: Code of the device, when the finding is about one.

quantity_id.description: The unknown quantity id, for UNKNOWN_QUANTITY.
